ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (35) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

The passages from 1 John and Mark are translated from Tolstoy's Russian wording, so «всем разумением твоим» (vsem razumeniyem tvoim) is 'with all your understanding', not the familiar 'mind', and pronouns for God follow the source's lowercase. «Человеколюбие» (chelovekolyubiye) is 'love of man', kept distinct from love for «человечество» (chelovechestvo, 'humanity'), and Tolstoy's repeated «есть» (yest', 'is') in the sixth thought is kept.
